content.what_it_is: MATLAB animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_time_spectra simple case, near-identical to tide_gen_abs_data/plot_wave.m with one addition: a per-frame time title. It loads eta_00001 to size the grid (L8, L10), builds x,y with dx=dy=2.0 (L11-L14), computes the analytic depth profile: -DEPTH_FLAT=-8.0 flat for x<Xslp=300.0, slope SLP=0.05 beyond (L4-L6, L16-L22). Opens MPEG-4 videoOut.mp4 at 10 fps, quality 100, target 576x1024 (L26-L31); jet colormap, 8x5-inch figure (L33-L36). Per frame nfile=1..99 (L24, L40): loads eta_<fnum> and mask_<fnum> (L42-L44), NaNs dry cells (L46), 3D mesh with axis [0 x(end) 0 y(end) -2 4], view(17,16) in subplot 1 (L50-L54), mid-row transect plus analytic depth line in subplot 2 (L56-L61), labels, and title 'time = <num*2> sec' (L70) implying a 2 s output interval; zbuffer renderer, pause, rasterize at 300 dpi, resize, store mov(num).cdata, write frame (L72-L80). Closes the video at L83; stale commented jpeg export at L87.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
DEPTH_FLAT — flat region depth in meters (L6)
eta — surface elevation array, reloaded per frame (L8, L43)
n, m — grid dimensions from size(eta) (L10)
mov — struct array of frame cdata (L78)

equations.ref: time label assuming 2 s output interval

io.name: two-panel per-frame figure: 3D mesh and mid-row transect with depth line

unresolved: The title formula num*2 (L70) asserts a 2 s output interval, which for a tide/spectra case must match PLOT_INTV in the case input; not verifiable here and inconsistent with tidal timescales if the case runs hours.
Analytic depth constants (SLP=0.05, Xslp=300, DEPTH_FLAT=8; L4-L6) are asserted to match the case bathymetry; unverifiable from this script.
ylabel only on num==1 is cleared by clf each frame (L49, L63-L65) and lands on the transect subplot.
mov(num).cdata accumulates all frames though each is written immediately (L78-L80).
Stale commented export name eta_inlet_shoal_irr.jpg (L87) copied from another case.
